title: Adversarial Bias: Data Poisoning Attacks on Fairness
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of fairness in traditional machine learning classifiers (such as Naive Bayes and Logistic Regression) by proposing a data poisoning attack. It uses tabular datasets (German Credit, Drug, COMPAS) and does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or philosophical ethics, nor does it involve Large Language Models.
